regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, DOI, and ESI availability line
regions.finding: Verified the source article title and aggregate current method claim. The page mentions ESI availability, but workspace SI association is unestablished and no SI fact was imported.
The Rh/Cu-cocatalyzed homo-coupling of generic allenols to (E)-2 is explicitly prior work (reference 3) and is classified as a literature example.
The Rh-catalyzed cross-coupling of generic allenoic acids and allenols to (E)-4 is explicitly prior work (reference 4), not a current-paper experiment.
The new three-component 1+3+Cu(OAc)2·H2O transformation to generic product 5 is a current general scheme; experiment-specific rows are represented separately.

regions.region: page 1 Results and Discussion initial experiment and optimization prose
regions.finding: The exact 1a 0.3 mmol/3a 0.2 mmol/[Cp*RhCl2]2 7.5 mol%/Cu(OAc)2·H2O 0.6 mmol/O2/CH3CN-MeOH/50 °C/13 h experiment is Scheme 2 equation 1 and Table 1 entry 1. Its 5aa/6aa/(E)-2a NMR yields are merged into one optimization record. The prose introduces entries 2–10 without duplicating them.

unresolved: Generic Scheme 1 R groups do not define unique structures, times, scales, or yields.
Operational workup/purification for the initial experiment is not reported in the main text.

regions.finding: Equation 1 is the same run as Table 1 entry 1 and retains exact charges plus 30/8/12% NMR product yields. Equation 2 is a separate (E)-4aa control: 5aa not detected and 86% starting material recovered.

regions.region: page 2 left-center Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–10, and footnotes a–f
regions.finding: Ten independent optimization rows were retained with atmosphere, CH3CN volume, fixed MeOH 30 uL, 3a/1a ratio, row/footnote times, catalyst and copper loadings, and three product-specific crude-NMR yields. Entry 1 is merged with Scheme 2 equation 1.

Three independent controls were retained: no-rhodium non-formation with 71%/67% NMR recovery of 1a/3a; NaOAc/O2 without copper gives 5aa 8% and 6aa 5% by NMR; KOAc/O2 without copper gives 6aa 5%, no 5aa, 48% NMR recovery of 1a, and no 3a recovery.

Three distinct labeling experiments were retained with >99% D substrate/product, D2O/MeOD 82% D product, and post-reaction D2O addition giving 0% D. The last experiment is represented as a 5 h standard reaction followed by a separate 11 h D2O stage with unreported temperature.
The prose introduces the proposed IN-1–IN-5 network and path A; it is linked to Scheme 4 on page 3 rather than treated as preparations.

unresolved: Most controls omit solvent volumes, workup, purification, isolated masses, detection limits, or analytical methods.
The temperature of the 11 h post-reaction D2O stage is not printed.
All isotope-resolved compact products remain structure-unverified.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Scheme 4 and continuation prose
regions.finding: Path A and the referee-suggested less-possible path B are proposed mechanisms. IN-1–IN-5/primed intermediates are not isolated reaction records.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Table 2 header, 21 product entries, and footnotes a–d
regions.finding: Twenty-one independent substrate-scope rows were retained with exact allenol/allenoic-acid labels, shared or footnote-overridden scale/loadings/solvents, N2/50 °C conditions, row-specific times, and yields. Footnotes for 0.5 mmol, no MeOH, and the 1a/3d ratio plus 3 equiv copper are explicit participants/amounts or conditions.
A distinct 8 mmol 1m run uses 1.5 equiv 3a, 5 mol% Rh dimer, 2 equiv copper acetate monohydrate, CH3CN, N2, 50 °C, 3.5 h and gives 5ma 1.0113 g/50%; it is not merged with Table 2 5ma.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Scheme 5 applications i–v and caption
regions.finding: Five application records were retained: two-step 5ma→7 with 63% combined yield; 5ma→8 (79%); 5ma→9 (84%, dr 2.6/1); one-pot 5ma→9→10 with 56% overall from 5ma; and 9→11 (64%). Ordered stages and every caption reagent/loading/time/temperature are structured.

unresolved: Table 2 and most Scheme 5 applications omit yield basis, workup, purification, and isolated masses.
The 63% for 7 and 56% for 10 are overall/combined yields and cannot be assigned to their final steps.
Compact products remain label-only and machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left completion of Scheme 5 application discussion
regions.finding: The text confirms the overall 56% yield from 5ma to diol 10 and 64% oxidation of hemiacetal 9 to beta-lactone 11; these enrich the page-3 application records and do not create duplicates.
The conclusion summarizes the reaction and proposed 1,4-H delivery or beta-H-elimination/insertion mechanisms; it adds no independent experiment.

Zhaoqiang Chen is thanked for reproducing results of 5bb, 5ha, and 5mc. Because no independent charges, conditions, outcomes, or run identifiers are given, this is provenance on existing scope records and creates no duplicate experiments.
Bibliography/review and prior-literature citations only; external papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

unresolved: The reproduction acknowledgment does not define separable runs.
Application yield bases and isolated masses are not reported.
No new reaction operation occurs in the conclusions or references.
